claims.content: The Auctioneer creates and maintains auction event profiles to define common characteristics for groups of products, enabling faster and more consistent scheduling while reducing data entry errors.

goal.raw_text: The Auctioneer creates and maintains auction event profiles to define common characteristics for groups of products, enabling faster and more consistent scheduling while reducing data entry errors.

claims.content: Auctioneer
The Auctioneer must access the Auction Event Profiles page to begin creating or editing a profile.
The Auctioneer decides to create a new auction event profile or edit an existing one to define common characteristics for a group of products.

trigger.raw_text: The Auctioneer decides to create a new auction event profile or edit an existing one to define common characteristics for a group of products.

claims.content: The Auctioneer accesses the Auction Event Profiles page.
To create a new profile, the Auctioneer clicks into the "Create New Profile" field, enters a name, and clicks "Create".
The Auctioneer fills in the cost tier ranges (upper range), while the system automatically populates the lower range of subsequent tiers.
For each cost tier, the Auctioneer selects a radio button for "amount" or "% of cost" and enters the opening bid value.
The Auctioneer designates a bid increment for all items in the cost tier.
The Auctioneer designates an auction duration for all items in the cost tier.
The Auctioneer chooses a radio button at the bottom to specify product eligibility (e.g., gemstones only, jewelry only, all items, or specific SKU prefix).
The Auctioneer clicks the "Apply" button to finish profile creation or save edits.
To edit an existing profile, the Auctioneer selects the profile from the list, modifies the values, and clicks "Apply" to save changes.

If the Auctioneer chooses a product eligibility option (e.g., 'Apply to Gemstones Only') and later attempts to apply the profile to a grouping of items that does not match that category (e.g., jewelry items), the system generates an error message indicating the profile can only be applied to products in the specified category.

If the Auctioneer selects a product eligibility restriction (e.g., 'Apply to Gemstones Only') during profile creation or editing, and subsequently attempts to apply that profile to a group of items outside the specified category (e.g., jewelry items), the system displays an error message stating the profile can only be applied to products in the designated category.
The auction event profile is successfully created or updated with the defined cost tiers, opening bids, bid increments, durations, and product eligibility rules.
The system provides a common set of characteristics for the group of products associated with the profile, enabling faster and more consistent scheduling.
Data entry errors are reduced through the use of the standardized profile settings.
If applied to specific items, the selected event profile settings (opening bid, increment, duration) are applied to all selected items.
